_comment: UFO Food Ltd weekly averages from the 1-7 & 8-14 Jun EPOS sample. Labour ~30% of net sales, FULLY LOADED (inc employer NI + pension). VAT treated as reclaimable and netting out, so costs are compared to net sales. Delivery real platform cost = 30% commission + 7% ads = 37% (the further ~14% the platform withholds is reclaimable VAT), so payout_rate (economic share kept) = 0.63. Delivery net already reflects a 15-20% menu price premium over counter. In-store/kiosk 1.0; own-app 0.90.
